# The -v flag also lists nested {{template}} calls.
#
# A {{template}} node is positioned at its name literal, so the node in
# index.gohtml sits at offset 11, which go/token calls column 12.
# ErrorContext, where the location comes from, counts columns from zero
# and would call it column 11.

check-templates -v
cmpenv stdout want.txt
! stderr .

-- want.txt --
$WORK/main.go:22:6	"index.gohtml"	example.com/app.Page
$WORK/index.gohtml:1:12	"index.gohtml"	example.com/app.Page
-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.25.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

var (
	//go:embed *.gohtml
	source embed.FS

	templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))
)

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

func render() {
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "index.gohtml", Page{})
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint

-- index.gohtml --
{{template "header.gohtml" .}}
<p>body</p>
-- header.gohtml --
<h1>{{.Title}}</h1>
